description: What a restore would do, shown before anything is overwritten.

agreement.description:
What this listing is, so consent given for it can name which listing it read.

Carried on every listing rather than only on the ones that would re-point
something: a surface that has to look for it is a surface that can fail to
find it, and a restore that would overwrite the same configuration in place
is still one somebody may agree to.

downgrade.description: Whether the archive is old enough that a compatibility warning applies.

manifest.description: The archive's own account of itself — its scope, version and contents.

relocation.description: The data-root difference, where the archive was taken against another one.
